goal: Unify agent-invocation across boards that declare dialogOrchestration: 'director' -- Domain/Realm uses DialogCastBar, IDE uses a different component (BoardInstrumentsBar), Designer uses BoardInstrumentsBar too. Same declared orchestration mode, two different implementations. Replace with one shared mechanism.

shipped.verified: BoardInstrumentsBar confirmed as the one shared component across Realm/Domain/IDE/Designer; DialogCastBar demoted to trailing Invite/Get key/Manage chrome. Real regression found and fixed same day: Domain board never got a boardInstruments list added, so old roster-scan logic (platformComposerSlugs exclusion, written for a different original purpose) silently dropped Cloud and Rendr from Realm's bar. Fixed by adding boardInstruments: ['cloud','rendr'] to the Domain board def and threading it through domainDirectorBoardInstruments the same way ideBoardInstruments already does. Compiles clean.
shipped.gap_found_after_shipping: Human/Ceox chip representation was fully removed with no replacement (not migrated into the new shared bar) -- decided acceptable by Chuck given only one human is on ke3p today; recorded as a parked question in the Becoming Together reference Document rather than an open bug.

superseded_context: Chuck reviewed the shipped result and raised three further real requirements that go beyond what this handoff scoped: (1) cast/identity should be managed through a universal header, not just the composer footer; (2) Kip (lead) should be invoked/active by default, always shown as a chip, not requiring a click; (3) Domain/Realm specifically needs true multi-select instrument invocation (several non-lead agents simultaneously active for collaboration) -- confirmed by code review that BoardInstrumentsBar's entire architecture is built around a single activeSlug, not a set; no multi-select mechanism exists anywhere today. Scoped as a new handoff, realm-header-cast-and-multiselect.
